draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.27, the 73rd-best grade among 255 2020 draftees and 5th of 21 at S. He went 68th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Tyvon Branch. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 55 tackles in 2019, 19th of 21 Ss in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 7 pro, currently with the San Francisco 49ers. 84 career games and 34 starts over 6 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (4 AV) was his best yet. Weak spots: missed tackle rate 18.8% (2nd percentile), passer rating allowed 121.8 (14th percentile). Versus the typical Year-6 safety who played: 66.7% season snap share against a median of 64.8%, above the norm.
